evidence.note: Reviewed the JSONL run store: path validation, O_NOFOLLOW opens, flock lifecycle, torn-tail repair, and fsync ordering; no eval, no TODO/FIXME, diff context complete.

Reviewed scenario loading: size cap, strict KnownFields decode, duplicate call/cmd key rejection, token validation, and the fake runner ordinal/repeat matching; companion internal/fsm/mockai/mockai_test.go exists in-tree.
isOpenBlocker now delegates to findings.Blocks; verified internal/findings/override.go:53 returns true for "open" and StatusOverridePending, so pending overrides still block as the comment claims.
Scanner buffer raised to maxJSONLLineBytes+2 (1 MiB + CRLF headroom), consistent with the documented bufio token-vs-buffer constraint.
Shard-plan tests derive hashes from the documented length-prefixed preimage rather than the implementation, and pin the bucketBits table; budget, split, and locality invariants are asserted.
Error formatting, Is/Code/As, unwrap chain, and Wrap field-copy isolation are all covered.

Marks judge prompt and fsm testdata fixtures as binary (-text) so CRLF normalization cannot perturb hashed golden fixtures; go.sum additions are limited to yaml.v3 and its check.v1 test dep, matching the new mockai YAML use.

findings.note: readRaw swallows non-EOF read errors: the loop breaks on any rerr without distinguishing io.EOF, so a partial read of audit.jsonl is returned as if it were the whole file. A truncated read would look like a torn tail, and RepairTail could then truncate durable events. Prefer io.ReadAll on the no-follow descriptor, or check errors.Is(rerr, io.EOF) and surface anything else as ERR_STORE_PATH.

evidence.note: for { n, rerr := f.Read(chunk); buf.Write(chunk[:n]); if rerr != nil { break } } — EOF and real I/O errors are handled identically.
